roots.title: First-Order Optimization Methods
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for First-Order Optimization Methods; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Smooth Deterministic Gradient Algorithms
children.top_down_role: Smooth deterministic gradient methods for unconstrained minimization, including stepsize policies, acceleration, momentum, spectral and adaptive scaling, nonlinear conjugate-gradient methods, complexity families, certificates, and failure regimes.

children.title: Conditional-Gradient Methods
children.top_down_role: Projection-free first-order optimization organized around linear minimization, conditional-gradient mechanisms, convergence and certificate families, active-set geometry, generalized variants, representation complexity, and failure regimes.

children.title: Nonsmooth Subgradient-Mirror-Bregman Algorithm Family
children.top_down_role: Nonsmooth first-order optimization through Euclidean subgradient schemes, non-Euclidean mirror geometry, dual averaging, and Bregman proximal constructions; smooth proximal splitting, bundle methods, saddle-point algorithms, and online learning theory remain separate owners.

children.title: Proximal-Composite Algorithm Family
children.top_down_role: Proximal regularization, proximal-point methodology, forward-backward composite optimization, prox-linear models, Moreau-envelope stationarity, and first-order methods for weakly convex objectives.

children.title: Foundational Operator-Splitting Taxonomy
children.top_down_role: Operator-theoretic navigation for fixed-point iterations, resolvent splittings, primal-dual realizations, convergence mechanisms, certificates, and distributed variants; formal statements and algorithm steps are excluded.

children.title: Primal-Dual ADMM Splitting Architectures
children.top_down_role: Primal-dual operator-splitting architectures and ADMM, including their representations, variants, certificates, convergence regimes, computational decompositions, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Fixed-Point Acceleration
children.top_down_role: Acceleration architectures for deterministic and stochastic fixed-point processes, their residual-complexity theory, operator-splitting transfers, implementation mechanisms, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Saddle-Point Variational Methods
children.top_down_role: First-order theory and computational structure for saddle-point problems, variational inequalities, monotone games, and closely associated minimax models; generic stochastic optimization and operator-splitting machinery remain cross-linked.

children.title: Stochastic Approximation-SGD Method Family
children.top_down_role: Stochastic recursive first-order methods, their oracle and noise models, convergence frameworks, optimization variants, guarantee regimes, averaging theory, computational interfaces, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Finite-Sum Variance-Reduction Methods
children.top_down_role: Finite-sum optimization structures, variance-reduced estimator architectures, associated first-order method families, sampling regimes, complexity theory, certificates, implementation mechanisms, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Self-Tuning Stochastic Method Families
children.top_down_role: Stochastic optimization methods that adapt to observed gradients, noise, geometry, scale, or feedback while reducing sensitivity to prior parameter knowledge.

children.title: Coordinate-Block Method Family
children.top_down_role: Methods that update selected coordinates, blocks, or operator components, together with their coordinate-specific geometry, complexity theory, computational interfaces, and failure regimes.

children.title: Sketched Subspace First-Order Methods
children.top_down_role: Randomized dimension reduction and subspace restriction as mechanisms for constructing, solving, and certifying large-scale first-order optimization models.

children.title: Learning-Optimizer First-Order
children.top_down_role: Learning-oriented stochastic first-order optimizers, their update geometries, scaling mechanisms, theoretical regimes, computational certificates, and characteristic failures; generic convex foundations, distributed execution, second-order optimization, reinforcement learning, and statistical generalization theory remain external.

children.title: Oracle Access Taxonomy
children.top_down_role: Information interfaces through which optimization procedures access objectives, operators, feasible sets, data, and structured subproblems, together with query accounting, comparative power, complexity principles, certificates, and failure boundaries.

children.title: First-Order Complexity Bound Taxonomy
children.top_down_role: Navigation for information-based lower bounds, optimal first-order complexity families, matching method families, randomized subspace models, and the boundaries under which rate comparisons remain valid.

children.title: Performance-Estimation Certificate Mechanisms
children.top_down_role: Navigation for worst-case performance estimation, exactness mechanisms, computer-assisted certificates, extremal constructions, and their limitations; formal statements and algorithm procedures are excluded.
